The imaging features strongly corroborate this, primarily the presence of necrosis ('Proportion Necrosis' of 5.24%) and thick contrast enhancement ('Thickness of enhancing margin': '>3mm'), which are hallmarks of glioblastoma, the most common IDH-wildtype tumor. Additionally, the sharp tumor-edema boundary, indicated by a small 'Transition Zone Thickness (FLAIR)' median of 1.415 mm, and the absence of a 'T2-FLAIR Mismatch Present' are both characteristic of IDH-wildtype gliomas.
